author: SIT™ Editorial
title: Landscaping — Why Spring Leads Need a Fall Head Start
content:
###  **The Timing Most Companies Miss** 

Homeowners plan spring landscaping projects months in advance — often starting the conversation in their own heads well before winter ends. Companies that are not already familiar by then are competing for attention during the busiest, most crowded season of the year. 

###  **What a Fall Head Start Looks Like** 

Territory presence built during fall and early winter positions a landscaping brand as the name homeowners already have in mind when spring planning begins — not one they discover during a rushed spring search. 

###  **A Real Example, Without the Name** 

One landscaping client we worked with expected every lead to convert immediately, but many homeowners were thinking ahead to spring rather than ready to book that week. The leads were real — the company simply was not set up to nurture interest that was not immediately ready to close. 

###  **The Follow-Up Gap** 

In a more competitive market, knowing what to do with a lead that says 'call me in spring' matters as much as generating the lead in the first place.
